description: The GTAP Data Base is the centrepiece of the Global Trade Analysis Project at Purdue University: a global database of bilateral trade, production, consumption and intermediate use of commodities and services, built for computable general equilibrium modelling. Releases go back to 1993; GTAP 12 was released in February 2026, GTAP 11 in April 2023 and GTAP 10 in July 2019. The database is updated every few years with contributions from a wide network of users, and concordances help map data to GTAP sectors and commodities. Access: the current version is sold to anyone who wants it, with proceeds funding the next release; older versions except the one before the current are free in the archives. Citation should reference the associated paper in the Journal of Global Economic Analysis. Caveats: each release describes a few reference years, sector detail is aggregated, and the current release is paid. For simulation it provides the economic structure and trade network used by CGE and input-output models of supply-chain shocks, disaster economic impacts and policy scenarios. Related catalogue records include the World Input-Output Database, EXIOBASE and Eora2.
